scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server
scripts.dev:container: concurrently -n "client,server" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:container --prefix client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.gen:api: npm run gen:openapi && npm run gen:api:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.verify:contracts: npm run gen:openapi && npm run verify:architecture
scripts.verify:local: npm run prisma:generate && npm run verify:ai-guide && npm run verify:package-scripts && npm run verify:runtime-config && npm run test:scripts && npm run verify:api-mutator && npm run verify:invariants && npm run verify:paired-rules && npm run verify:prisma-migrations && npm run verify:contracts && npm run verify:gates && npm run verify:maintainability && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test --prefix server && npm run test:e2e --prefix server && npm run test:run --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.verify:template: npm run prisma:generate && npm run verify:prisma-migrations && npm run prisma:push && npm run verify:ai-guide && npm run verify:package-scripts && npm run verify:runtime-config && npm run test:scripts && npm run verify:api-mutator && npm run verify:invariants && npm run verify:paired-rules && npm run gen:api && npm run verify:architecture && npm run verify:gates && npm run verify:maintainability && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test --prefix server && npm run test:e2e --prefix server && npm run test:run --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && npm run verify:smoke:server && npm run format:check && npm run audit:all && npm run verify:e2e:critical -- --skip-build
scripts.audit:all: npm audit && npm --prefix client audit && npm --prefix server audit
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix client audit --omit=dev && npm --prefix server audit --omit=dev
